nine_class_task.input: RGB plus provided annotated target-person box
nine_class_task.historical_exposure: four-class test subset previously inspected; remaining labels extend a partly exposed benchmark

current_queue.feature_extraction: CUDA; shared train/validation-only pool; task-specific aligned labels
current_queue.preprocessing: historical POLAR control for DINOv2; pinned or explicitly provenance-marked recovered official-library processor for challengers

rbf_head.calibration: five_source_grouped_folds; training-only scaling and sigmoid fitting

nine_class_adaptation.initialization: original pinned DINOv2 foundation; never historical train+validation final checkpoint
nine_class_adaptation.confirmation: select recipe using only seed42 validation macro-F1/NLL; lock it before seeds52/62; keep all three seeds

current_queue.stop_after: development_report; independent review before final fitting or any test evaluation

subsequent_required_phases: Review development results and model availability, selected checkpoint replay, source/provenance integrity, view and representation ablations.
Run bounded adapted modern challengers with three seeds; weak frozen ConvNeXt is not a sufficient convolutional comparator.
Freeze exact standalone/fusion recipes, training budgets, metrics and complete list of confirmatory comparisons before final refit.
Refit from foundation weights on permitted development data; use fixed epoch budgets; evaluate declared test cohorts in one batch, never tune using scores.
Compare four-class challengers to saved historical ensemble predictions on identical3329rows; keep nine-class original/audited results distinct.
Compute per-class metrics, NLL/Brier/calibration, paired stratified/source-group sensitivity bootstrap, Holm-controlled comparisons, seed variance, error transitions and cost.
If benchmark superiority is supported, describe its exact scope and date; no general deployment or original-paper SOTA claim without matched external evidence.

confidence_gate.paired_macro_f1_interval: 95percent lower bound >0 against prespecified strongest comparable challenger; multiple-comparison adjustment declared before test
confidence_gate.replication: three-seed evidence with no favorable-seed selection
confidence_gate.integrity: exact row/label order, verified data/checkpoints/caches, validated optimizer and saved-checkpoint prediction replay
confidence_gate.inconclusive: interval includeszero -> competitive/uncertain, not clear superiority
confidence_gate.independent_confirmation: genuinely untouched data required for claims of fresh confirmation after test-driven development; reshuffling used images is not independence

known_limits: No fresh all-nine-class embedding-retrieval overlap audit yet.
Pretraining overlap with foundation model corpora cannot be ruled out.
Provided person boxes exclude detection/tracking errors.
No verified original POLAR paper numerical baseline table yet.
Winning the present bounded panel is not proof of global best performance.
